Frequently asked

Do I need an account?
No. Everything you save is kept on your device.

Where are my saved myths and quotes?
In the Library tab, under Saved, Finished and Quotes.

How do I change the text size or switch to night mode?
While reading a myth, tap Aa for the text size and the moon or sun for night and day. You can also set both in Account → Reading preferences.

Can the app read a myth aloud?
Yes. Tap Listen on a myth to hear the story told by your device's voice, paragraph by paragraph, at the speed you choose.

Will I lose my library if I change phones?
For now, yes: your library lives only on the device where you saved it.

How do I erase everything?
Account → Delete my data. You will be asked to confirm first.

Does it work offline?
Yes. All stories and paintings are included in the app.

Where do the paintings come from?
From Wikimedia Commons, under public-domain or Creative Commons licences. Each myth and character page credits the artist, the work and its licence and links to the source.
